summary: BESLENCE AI full backend + frontend testing iteration 1. 23/23 pytest backend tests PASSED including: health, auth (invalid+valid token), Mifflin-St Jeor for both sexes (male erkek BMR=1780, female kadin BMR=1345), safety floor (women >=1200 kcal), profile theme switch, full entry CRUD, AI chatbot Turkish parsing for 4 message types ('13:30 tavuklu pilav ayran', 'Şu an 500 ml su içtim', 'Yarın 19:00 gym planla', 'Dün 20:00 pizza'), no-advice verification, photo analyze with real food JPEG, foods/lookup for 'mercimek çorbası', daily and weekly summaries. Frontend mobile-first testing via Playwright (390x844): splash with logo/tagline/CTA buttons (create-goal-button & existing-account-button) renders, /auth shows google-signin-button, after seeding session token to localStorage the dashboard tab loads correctly with hero card (calorie target 1200-1300 kcal, macro pills Protein/Karb/Yağ/Su/Lif/Aktivite, action buttons Besin/Aktivite/Güncel/Planla, timeline list). Calendar tab shows day strip + 'Bugün' pill + 4 action buttons + Günlük çizelge. Chatbot tab works end-to-end: sent 'Şu an 250 ml su içtim' -> bot reply 'Şu an için 250 ml su içme kaydınızı sisteme ekledim' with rendered entry card (250 ml Su, time 19:07, 0-0 kcal). Profile tab shows user info, Sakin/Sportif theme switch, plan card (BMR 926, maintenance 1112, hedef 1200-1300), weekly summary bars. Add screen has 5 tabs (Besin/Aktivite/Güncel/Planla/Geçmiş). Onboarding/goal step 1/7 renders. No deprecated Expo packages found (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch).

issues: Non-blocking console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' coming from one of the styled components (likely SHADOW.card preset in theme). Recommended migration to React Native 0.76+ boxShadow API.

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow per RN 0.76 deprecation warning (cosmetic, non-blocking).
Optional: align review_request testID expectations (chatbot-input/chatbot-send) with actual implementation (chat-input/chat-send-btn) or rename in component for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 858 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, profile, entries, ai, summary) when >700 lines threshold matters.
google_session endpoint trusts external session_token verbatim and upserts user by email; this is by design for Emergent Google Auth, OK for MVP.
ChatGPT/Gemini responses parsed via regex JSON extraction with fallback. If LLM returns malformed JSON, endpoint returns ok=false; covered.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (splash, auth, dashboard, calendar, chatbot send+reply, profile, add tabs, onboarding step 1)

seed_data_creation: Seeded user_test01 + session_token 'test_session_token_001' in MongoDB (users + user_sessions). Created profile via POST /api/profile during testing. Cleared entries for user_test01 before tests; remaining TEST_ prefixed entries exist after run (not cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test session token 'test_session_token_001' for user_id 'user_test01' is seeded. Inject via: localStorage.setItem('beslence_session_token', JSON.stringify('test_session_token_001')) then reload. Web AsyncStorage on this app uses localStorage directly. Chatbot testIDs are chat-input / chat-send-btn / chat-mic-btn (not chatbot-*). EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://ai-food-logger-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Pytest run: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_beslence_backend.py -v.
